civilopediaText.text: The scenario's calendar: the day of June. It is shown in the top bar next to the turn number.
June 6, D-Day: turns 0-16, one hour each. The night of June 6-7: turns 17-18. June 7: turns 19-27, two hours each. The night of June 7-8: turns 28-29. June 8: turns 30-38.
The scenario's clock: the hour at the start of this turn, on the 24-hour clock (13 is 1 PM). It is shown in the top bar next to the turn number.
D-Day runs hour by hour from 6 AM to 10 PM; June 7 and 8 in two-hour turns from 5 AM. Each night passes in two turns, at midnight and 3 AM.
1 when you have turned off the scenario's history messages, otherwise 0.
